text:
lina: FYI sampleapp CI started failing after today's typegen regen. stack traces point at auth retry behavior.
aj: saw that. Error looks like a runtime undefined on AuthClient.retry() in the browser build.
tyler: can you paste the failing stack? I.e. from the CI logs.
lina: here — truncated:

```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'call' of undefined
  at AuthClient.retry (sdk/auth.ts:123:12)
  at doRequest (sdk/request.ts:45:8)
```
aj: quick grep shows our generated auth.ts changed ordering of exported helpers. local repro: `yarn --cwd examples/sampleapp build` fails.
regen-bot: regen diff summary: sdk/auth.ts — 1 file changed, 14 insertions(+), 11 deletions(-)
aj: diff snippet:
```
- export function shouldRetry(err) { ... }
- export class AuthClient { retry(err) { ... } }
+ export class AuthClient { retry(err) { ... } }
+ export function shouldRetry(err) { ... }
```
mike: that reorder should be harmless normally, but our bundler relies on hoisting in dev builds. :facepalm:
aj: bundler? which one — esbuild or webpack for sampleapp? we switched to esbuild for faster dev mode.
tyler: esbuild has a known edge where cyclical imports + changed export order can break tree-shaking in some configs. I've seen similar with generated index files.
sarah: ok immediate idea — pin typegen generator to previous working release in sampleapp package.json and re-run CI while we investigate.
lina: +1. but this surfaced because auth/retry semantics changed subtly in the new typegen (it now sets default retry behaviour at top-level). That may be a breaking change we missed in semver/changelog.
aj: did we add a changelog entry? I couldn't find one in the typegen release notes.
regen-bot: released typegen v0.8.0 at 1872502000 — changelog: "internal reorder: exports and builder optimizations" (no mention of auth default behavior)
mike: that's problematic. users relying on export order or import side-effects are fragile but we still need to note behavioral changes in changelog.
tyler: proposal: revert the default-retry change and ship a minor with explicit opt-in, and in parallel update sampleapp to pin typegen and add a test that runs a full bundle build.
sarah: sounds good. also create a devex checklist for typegen releases: run sampleapp builds, run browser bundle smoke tests, and include any export reorder notes in changelog.
aj: opened a quick PR to pin typegen in sampleapp: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/482 — CI rerun queued.
lina: if CI still fails after pin, I'll attach the full bundle js and we can bisect.
tyler: cc @sarah please add the release checklist to the release playbook doc.
sarah: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
aj: followup — can we add a regen CI job that runs `yarn build` in all example apps on typegen publish? would catch this earlier.
mike: agree. opened issue #241 on devex infra.
regen-bot: note: next typegen publish should include a semver note and the release checklist checkbox.
lina: closing for now — sampleapp CI rerun looks green after pin. I'll keep this thread updated if anything else pops up.
aj: thanks — great triage team!
